Duke, Rosie and Pip

Start with one doberman, add the others from the menu, give each an expression and save the scene as a GIF you can send.

Dogs in the scene
Expression
Play

  • Tap a dog to set off its reaction for the expression it's wearing.
  • Press and drag across a dog to pet it. Its eyes follow your pointer.
  • Throw a treat to the selected dog, or call them and watch every ear go up, Pip's included.
